symptom: Mixed source/output frame grids and nested concat required endpoint correction in the direct-cut MV timeline.
root_cause: Time-based clip trims and output-frame rounding can disagree at joins. This is a local compiler integration observation, not a universal FFmpeg defect.
fix: Project renderer converts to target fps before frame-index trims, performs one concat, and resets PTS on the output grid. Final 274.880-second render decoded to 6872 frames at 25fps with valid frame steps.
prevention: For direct cuts, allocate output frame counts explicitly and verify final decode, cut boundaries, end frame and audio offset. This project adaptation rejects transitions; do not copy it to transition timelines without validation.
